findings.text: §4 makes `checkpoint_at(upstream, when)` resolve "the recorder file for that origin", but no recorder row or file carries the port: the file is named `<slug>-$SLURM_JOB_ID.jsonl` (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:627) and a row holds `hostname`, `job_id`, `timestamp` and `serve_config` (serving_receipts.py:196–216), none of them the port; under the overlap path §5 accepts, the old and the replacement serve run side by side on one node with the same slug and overlapping row spans, so two files match the origin and the join returns the wrong `model_path`

findings.reason: the reasoning rubric requires the mechanism that produces the measure to run on a real code path with a named caller; with none, the recorded outcome is unreachable by any reader.
findings.text: `serving_receipts.checkpoint_at` is named the one owner of the join but has no caller anywhere in the plan, and §4's write paths (registry.py, slurm.py, serving_receipts.py and three test modules) contain no consumer of it, so the join never runs on a production path

findings.reason: the plan's own §3 makes its stated reason false, and a real CLI refusal on the dry-run path is the control that shows the guard fires outside the test harness.
findings.text: §5 rejects the copied-profile control because "`restart` finds no running job under a new slug and refuses before the preflight is reached", but that refusal is gated on `if len(jobs) != 1 and not dry_run` (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2386) and §3 now makes the preflight run in `--dry-run`, which never touches the lane; the stronger real-path control (`restart <copy> --dry-run` on an erring weights directory must print the preflight refusal) is therefore available and is passed over for a unit test re-run

findings.reason: two concurrent nodes on one file is the one-worktree-one-writer rule broken by the plan's own fan-out instruction, and the collision lands as a merge the coordinator must resolve blind.
findings.text: §2 and §4 both list `imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py` in their write paths (§2 needs it to pass the pinned revision to the HF client, §4 to write `checkpoint` from the profile at serve start), while the followup has §2, §3 and §4 "write disjoint files and run in parallel" (line 266)
